Redraw it with ONE circular path around the fountain basin, and the straight paths that lead to it meeting that circle at clean junctions on all four sides, including the lower left, so nothing is left unconnected; lawn between. Keep the fountain itself and the trees.

The lawn in the outline, north-west of the MAPLEWOOD storefronts, has faint blotches and pale stripes. Redraw it as clean, even lawn; every tree in it whole and crisp; the footpaths that cross the outline keep their exact position and width.
